name: Dutch Nationality Option Procedure (Long-Term Residence)

requirements.blocker_text: The IND option-procedure page states this ground applies to a person who 'has been living in the Kingdom of the Netherlands for a long time,' without specifying an exact number of years in the content reviewed -- likely a shorter/different threshold than the 5-year naturalisation route, but not confirmed.
Must not pose a danger to public order or national security.

evidence_required.document: Attendance at the naturalisation ceremony and Declaration of Solidarity

sources.title: IND -- Becoming a Dutch national through option: five grounds including 'long-term residence in the Kingdom of the Netherlands', without a stated duration in the content reviewed

notes: STATUS: DRAFT, part of Curacao's initial build. This is the one ground of the IND's 5-ground option procedure (option, not naturalisation) that a migrant could plausibly qualify for through their own residence rather than through birth or parental recognition; the other four grounds (born in the Kingdom, recognised by a Dutch parent, born before 1985 to a Dutch mother, former Dutch national) are birth/family-status grounds rather than migration routes and are not modelled as their own files, consistent with this dataset's treatment of automatic-by-birth provisions elsewhere (see e.g. ai_belonger_status_descent.json's notes on the same issue for Anguilla). Marked draft because the fetched IND content did not state the actual residence-duration threshold for this ground (only 'a long time'), and the option procedure is understood in general Dutch-nationality-law terms to typically require a SHORTER residence period than the 5-year naturalisation route and/or to skip the language/civic-integration exam -- neither of which is confirmed here, so this route should not be treated as equivalent to or a clear shortcut over cw_naturalisation.json without further sourcing. Whether this ground also requires renouncing prior nationality was not confirmed either (dual_citizenship_allowed left null, unlike the false set on cw_naturalisation.json where the source was explicit).
